dingtalk.description: DingTalk group custom-robot webhook client. The webhook URL comes from the DINGTALK_WEBHOOK connector env (user fills it via the authorization form). Message body is passed via stdin to avoid quoting issues.

tools.name: send_text
tools.description: Send a plain-text message to a DingTalk group via the custom robot webhook. The payload parameter must be the FULL JSON request body written to stdin, shaped exactly as {"msgtype":"text","text":{"content":"消息内容"}}. Use \n for line breaks inside content. Requires user approval.

tools.name: send_markdown
tools.description: Send a Markdown message to a DingTalk group via the custom robot webhook. The payload parameter must be the FULL JSON request body written to stdin, shaped exactly as {"msgtype":"markdown","markdown":{"title":"标题","text":"**支持的** Markdown 正文"}}. The title shows in the notification bar. Requires user approval.

params.name: payload
params.description: Full JSON request body, e.g. {"msgtype":"markdown","markdown":{"title":"title","text":"markdown body"}}
